title: Sets, Venn diagrams and power sets
instructions:
## Two sets in a universe

Let U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, A = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6} and B = {2, 4, 5, 6, 8}. The **Sets** tool draws the Venn diagram and computes the usual operations; change A and B to explore.

## Do this

Answer the questions on the right. Write sets in braces, like `{1, 2}`, and the empty set as `{}`.
hints: A − B keeps the members of A that are not in B.
The complement of A is everything in U that is not in A.
A set with n members has 2ⁿ subsets.

checks.label: (A ∪ B)ᶜ
